summary: Redmond, WA resident, former employee of Adapx, ex-ASE-certified mechanic, avid cyclist with a preference for steel-framed bikes, owner of a Nissan Leaf, experienced in software development and technical writing, strong advocate for education and demonstrable experience over formal degrees, critical of corporate practices and marketing strategies, engaged in discussions about electric vehicles and their infrastructure, has a history of heart arrhythmia, vegetarian, enjoys running and endurance sports, skeptical of mainstream media narratives, and has a strong interest in technology and its societal implications.
